name: Single-Arm Band Pull Apart
instructions: Anchor one end of a light band at chest height, or hold it in your fixed hand in front of your chest.
Hold the other end in your working hand with the arm straight out in front of you at shoulder height.
Keep the elbow straight and move the working hand out to your side until the arm is in line with your shoulder. Keep your shoulder blades back and down.
Pause, then return to the start under control.
Do all the reps on one side, then change sides.
